json.name: space.new
json.about: Make a space: its name (default: none, so it's called after where its first terminal is), the folder its terminals start in (default: the focused terminal's), its first tab's name (default: none, so it's called by its number), optionally an agent (argv) and its first message (task), and the machine it lives on (`hc machine ls`; default the focused space's machine for keys and clicks, this computer for scripts; empty string: this computer; its terminals start in that machine's home unless folder).

json.name: space.close
json.about: Close a space and end its terminals (asks first unless confirmed).

json.name: space.rename
json.about: Rename a space (asks the person when no name; an empty name: called after where its first terminal is again).

json.name: space.move
json.about: Move a space to a position (1 = first).

json.name: tab.new
json.about: Make a tab in a space (default: the selected one; name default: none, so it's called by its number) with a terminal in folder (default: the focused terminal's), optionally an agent (argv) and its first message (task); or with a mod as its only pane (`mod`, its `props`: a file, a board). With no space open, a person's new tab starts a space (as space.new).

json.name: tab.close
json.about: Close a tab and end its terminals.

json.name: tab.rename
json.about: Rename a tab (asks the person when no name; an empty name: called by its number again).

json.name: tab.move
json.about: Move a tab to a position in its space (1 = first).

json.name: pane.split
json.about: Split a pane (default: the focused one) "right" or "down" with a new terminal, or with a mod (`mod`, its `props`) beside it.

json.name: pane.close
json.about: Close a pane and end its terminal.

json.name: terminal.open
json.about: Start a terminal: as a new tab (place "tab", default), or "right"/"down" of the focused pane.

json.name: terminal.keep
json.about: Give a running terminal without a pane (a sub-agent) a pane: a new tab, or "right"/"down".

json.name: terminal.park
json.about: Take a terminal's pane away and disable core keep; it keeps running (a sub-agent shows under its parent again).

json.name: terminal.right_click
json.about: Where right-clicks in a terminal (default: the focused one) go when its program takes the mouse: "program" or "menu" (Herdr's, the default). Shift+right-click is always the menu.

json.name: terminal.pin
json.about: Pin an agent to the top of the agent lists (pinned true) or unpin it (false). Pins are kept with the terminal, so every Herdr client shows them, and end with it.

json.name: terminal.kill
json.about: End a terminal and its sub-agents.

json.name: space.select
json.about: Show a space (by position or id).

json.name: space.next
json.about: Show the next space.

json.name: space.prev
json.about: Show the previous space.

json.name: tab.select
json.about: Show a tab (by position in the space, or id).

json.name: tab.settle
json.about: Put a tab away on this screen (default: the shown one): out of the lists, still running. It comes back when shown or when an agent in it needs you.

json.name: tab.unsettle
json.about: Bring a settled tab back to the lists.

json.name: tab.next
json.about: Show the next tab.

json.name: tab.prev
json.about: Show the previous tab.

json.name: pane.zoom
json.about: Show only this pane of its tab, or all again.

json.name: pane.focus
json.about: Focus a pane (or the pane showing a terminal).

json.name: pane.go
json.about: Focus the pane or focusable mod to the "left", "right", "up" or "down".

json.name: pane.swap
json.about: Swap the focused pane with its neighbor in a direction.

json.name: terminal.peek
json.about: Peek at a running terminal over the tab, with keep-as-tab and close controls.

json.name: terminal.show
json.about: Show a terminal in a pane for now, in place of its own (no terminal: back).

json.name: terminal.copy
json.about: Copy the focused terminal's selection. With nothing selected, that key goes to the program.

json.name: terminal.scroll
json.about: Scroll a terminal's view of its history (default: the focused one). Give exactly one of: lines (a whole number; negative goes up, toward history), pages (a number, fractions allowed; one page is the terminal's rows), to: "top" (oldest history) or "bottom" (the live screen). This scrolls Herdr's view, not the program.

json.name: terminal.paste
json.about: Paste into the focused terminal (copied files as if dropped; an image alone as terminal.paste_image pastes it).

json.name: terminal.paste_image
json.about: Ctrl+V: the clipboard's image as a file on the focused terminal's machine, when that's another one; on Windows, paste clipboard text; otherwise Ctrl+V goes to the terminal.

json.name: terminal.search
json.about: Search the focused terminal's screen and scrollback; the find bar and query stay with that terminal.

json.name: agent.focus
json.about: Show an agent (sub-agents too).

json.name: agent.next
json.about: Show the next agent, in the order the agents list shows them.

json.name: agent.prev
json.about: Show the previous agent.

json.name: layout.switch
json.about: Show a layout (layouts/<name>.json), or the next one.

json.name: layout.clone
json.about: Duplicate a layout as <name>-copy (or as), then show it.

json.name: mod.clone
json.about: Duplicate a mod as <name>-copy (or as).

json.name: layout.set
json.about: Replace a personal layout tree; shipped layouts accept only click/look fields (not structure).

json.name: layout.toggle
json.about: Hide or show a layout node.

json.name: layout.show
json.about: Show a layout node.

json.name: layout.hide
json.about: Hide a layout node.

json.name: layout.resize
json.about: Size a layout node.

json.name: layout.select
json.about: Show one child of a stack.

json.name: layout.reset
json.about: Reset a shipped layout and its clicks (the old file is kept aside).

json.name: mod.open
json.about: Toggle a mod as the overlay its mod.json describes; calling again closes it.

json.name: overlay.close
json.about: Close an overlay (default: the top dialog or popup).

json.name: app.help
json.about: Toggle the keys dialog.

json.name: app.welcome
json.about: Show the welcome again.

json.name: app.whats_new
json.about: Show what this release brought (it opens once by itself after an update).

json.name: app.feedback
json.about: Draft feedback for the person to review and send (from: person or agent).

json.name: app.palette
json.about: Toggle the command palette: every command by name, with its key; calling again closes it.

json.name: app.settings
json.about: Open the settings (section: look, alerts, updates).

json.name: app.check_updates
json.about: Look for a newer Herdr and herdr-core now.

json.name: app.update_core
json.about: Update herdr-core to its latest release of this generation; terminals keep running.

json.name: app.reset
json.about: The escape hatch: set the shown layout and keys aside, back to the default screen.

json.name: app.theme
json.about: Use a theme (a preset or themes/<name>.json).

json.name: app.zoom_in
json.about: Make everything bigger.

json.name: app.zoom_out
json.about: Make everything smaller.

json.name: app.zoom_reset
json.about: Back to normal size.

json.name: app.update
json.about: Restart into the update Herdr downloaded (your terminals keep running).

json.name: app.quit
json.about: Quit (macOS).

json.name: app.hide
json.about: Hide the app (macOS).

json.name: app.hide_others
json.about: Hide other apps (macOS).

json.name: app.show_all
json.about: Show all apps (macOS).

json.name: window.close
json.about: Close the window (on Linux, quits).

json.name: window.minimize
json.about: Minimize the window.

json.name: window.maximize
json.about: Maximize the window, or back.

notes: The command registry over the socket (same list as `herdr-app commands`).
